system.description: Action: perform the Equipment action and spend up to (SL × 5) MP; each 5 MP buys one option, once each: swap Hunter Weapons with one ally you can see; a free attack with a weapon equipped this turn, High Roll 0; or reduce the next damage you suffer before your next turn by (SL), before Affinities.
